verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Ironclad accepting natural-language commands to operate the product. The Ironclad AI pages offer only taglines with no description of a conversational or command interface. The REST APIs, the llms.txt docs file, and the API guide on AI-driven analysis are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a natural-language way to operate the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
